description: This module provides utility functions for post-processing and normalizing subtitle entries in a subtitle correction pipeline. It includes functionality to apply corrections, compare and decide whether to update subtitles based on timing and textual differences, and merge proposed corrections into original subtitles with conservative rules.

methods.name: str apply_additional_compliance_fixes(path: str, processed_dir: str)
methods.description: Applies post-processing corrections to a subtitle file by copying its content to a new file in a specified directory.

methods.name: List[str] _extract_words(text: str)
methods.description: Extracts lowercase alphanumeric word tokens from input text, ignoring punctuation and whitespace.

methods.name: bool _should_update_text(old: str, new: str)
methods.description: Determines if the subtitle text should be updated by comparing word content, ignoring punctuation, case, and whitespace.

methods.name: bool _time_change_is_significant(old_start: float, old_end: float, new_start: float, new_end: float)
methods.description: Checks if the change in start or end times between old and new timestamps is at least 1 second.

methods.name: Dict conservative_merge_subtitle_update( original: Dict, proposal: Dict, )
methods.description: Merges a proposed subtitle correction into an original subtitle with conservative rules, only updating timestamps if the change is significant and text if the word content differs.

search-terms: text comparison ignore punctuation casing whitespace

ctags.name: _time_change_is_significant
ctags.pattern: /^def _time_change_is_significant(old_start: float, old_end: float, new_start: float, new_end: flo/
ctags.signature: (old_start: float, old_end: float, new_start: float, new_end: float)
